selector.rationale: The patient has a history of HBV-positive hepatocellular carcinoma and the presence of multiple nodules in liver segments and a right-flank soft tissue mass invading the 12th rib, which supports the diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma with extrahepatic metastasis.

rejected.label: Soft tissue sarcoma
rejected.why: Although a primary soft tissue sarcoma could not be excluded, the clinical history and imaging findings are more consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma with extrahepatic metastasis.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease to the lung
rejected.why: This diagnosis is too narrow and does not account for the full range of clinical and imaging findings.

rejected.label: hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis does not account for the extrahepatic metastasis
